title: Baining people - Wikipedia
text: The Baining people are an ethnic group indigenous to the Gazelle Peninsula of East New Britain, Papua New Guinea; they currently inhabit the Baining Mountains, from which they take their name. They are considered a genetic isolate and speak the Baining languages, with each language corresponding to separate clan identities.
